summary: Form 8-K filed by Whitehawk Therapeutics (issuer) on May 21, 2026, reporting a press release that announces an option agreement with Hangzhou DAC Biotechnology for access to linker-payload CPT113 for up to five new ADC programs, plus data presentation at ASCO. No financial terms, share price, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or activist campaign. It is a routine business development update expanding pipeline through a licensing option. No special-situation event is triggered.
